name: @oojae/strk20-governance
description: Sealed-ballot governance primitives for the STRK20 shielded pool on Starknet.
author: OoJae
//: main and types point at TypeScript source, which is what the workspace
consumes — apps/web transpiles it and the tally service runs it directly,
so there is no build step between editing a helper and running a tally.
publishConfig overrides both at publish time, so what goes to the registry
is compiled JavaScript with declarations. Consumers never see .ts source
they would have to configure a toolchain to read.

src ships alongside dist because the emitted sourcemaps point at it. Maps that resolve to files nobody has are worse than no maps: a consumer's debugger shows a path and then an empty pane. Nothing resolves to src — publishConfig points main, types and exports at dist — so it is there to be read, not to be loaded.
